description: Read the channel rates saved for your workspace: what each sales channel, such as a shopping agent or an agent marketplace, keeps of a sale, and how much of that cut is added to the price. released says whether channel pricing is on for your workspace; rates are saved either way and apply only while it is on. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_channel_rates
